name: Asangathit Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Asangathit Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 April 2018.
descriptionMd: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &amp;quot;Asangathit Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana&amp;quot; for unorganized worker on 10 April 2018. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial help for the delivery assistance.
eligibilityMd:
1. Applicant must be registered unorganized worker.
1. Applicant can be male or female.
1. Applicant will be not eligible if he/she is contract workers, female domestic workers, porters and sanitation workers.
